listing.name: Guitar Hero II (Xbox 360) — Guitar Hero II Recompiled (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Upstream marks gameplay as working. Guitar-controller support has not been tested. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Guitar Hero II (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own Guitar Hero II disc into assets, then follow upstream instructions to analyze the XEX, generate code and compile the Windows player.

warnings: Upstream marks gameplay as working. Guitar-controller support has not been tested.
